merge_raw_profiles: merge raw .profraw coverage profiles into a single indexed .profdata file using llvm-profdata
prepare_html_report: prepare an html code coverage report for instrumented binaries using llvm-cov show
prepare_html_reports: generate html coverage reports for one or multiple binaries as unified or per-binary reports
run_coverage_merge_only: run the script with --only-merge to merge raw profiles without generating html reports
run_coverage_with_restrict: run the script to generate coverage reports restricted to specific source paths
